Training & learning

Local learning, clearly organised.

C-TECH Jamaica/MOHW learning is placed first. The training cards are preloaded into the page and then enhanced by JavaScript, so this section does not disappear if a dynamic feature fails.

C-TECH
C-TECHSELF-ENROL · 2025–26

Telehealth in HIV Care and Treatment

Jamaica-focused telemedicine training for HIV care and treatment, including Jamaica Telemedicine SOPs.

2–4 hours↗
Open learning resource →

C-TECHSELF-ENROL · 2025–26

Viral Load Counselling and Education

Viral-load monitoring, result explanation and enhanced adherence-counselling support for healthcare workers.

2–5 hours↗
Open learning resource →

C-TECHSELF-ENROL · 2025–26

Fast Track Cities — Clinical Management of HIV

Eight-module HIV capacity-building series with a strong focus on eliminating stigma in healthcare settings.

3–5 hours↗

Roles & functions

Who does what across the response.

A practical, evidence-informed directory of national, regional, parish and service-delivery roles supporting the response. It is designed for orientation and does not replace an official MOHW establishment chart.

How the National Programme Works

A functional view of the national, regional, parish and service-delivery workforce supporting Jamaica’s HIV/STI/TB response. Staffing and exact reporting arrangements may vary by region and site.

NATIONALMOHW · National Programme Leadership & Technical FunctionsProgramme leadership · Treatment, Care & Support · Strategic Information · psychosocial support · clinical mentoring · programme administration · surveillance/epidemiology · TB/STI/PMTCT technical functions
↓
REGIONALRegional Health Authority HIV/STI/TB TeamRegional HIV/STI/TB Coordinator · Regional TCSO · Regional Contact Investigator · BCC · surveillance · psychology · medical social work · PMTCT · data management · liaison functions
↓
PARISHParish Programme Coordination & Field DeliveryMedical Officer (Health) · Parish TCS Officer · CI supervision & Contact Investigators · PMTCT · BCC/prevention · community intervention · data/reporting support
↓
FACILITY / COMMUNITYMultidisciplinary Treatment, STI, TB & Community TeamsMedical Officers · FNP/NP where deployed · nurses · pharmacy · psychosocial team · laboratory · nutrition · records/data · obstetric/paediatric services · community and outreach personnel
Important: This is a functional programme map for orientation, not an official MOHW establishment chart. Team composition varies by region, parish and service site.

Staff roles & functions

Search across national, regional, parish and multidisciplinary service roles. Exact staffing varies by RHA, parish and site.

Senior Medical Officer / National Programme Technical Leadership

National

Provides national technical leadership for HIV/STI/TB programme policy, clinical guidance, programme standards and technical coordination.

Key functions
  • Technical oversight of programme guidance and priorities
  • Clinical and programme policy leadership
  • Coordination with MOHW branches, regions and partners
Source / reference ↗

Regional HIV/STI/TB Coordinator

Regional

Coordinates implementation of HIV/STI/TB programme activities across the health region and receives programme reporting and technical input.

Key functions
  • Regional programme coordination
  • Monitor implementation and reporting
  • Coordinate with parishes and regional technical leadership
Source / reference ↗

Regional Contact Investigator

Regional

Regional supervisory CI function supporting quality assurance, programme monitoring, audits, capacity building and complex cross-parish investigations.

Key functions
  • Review parish CI work and reports
  • Support QA, audits, training and mentoring
  • Coordinate complex or cross-parish CI activities
  • Analyse regional CI/STI/HIV programme data
Source / reference ↗

Medical Officer (Health)

Parish

Provides parish public-health leadership and technical/administrative oversight for programme implementation.

Key functions
  • Parish technical oversight
  • Receive programme reports and recommendations
  • Support implementation of national guidance
  • Supervise designated parish programme leads
Source / reference ↗

Senior Contact Investigator

Parish supervisory

Plans, coordinates and quality-assures parish Contact Investigation activities, reporting, audits, training and programme follow-up.

Key functions
  • Plan CI work and itineraries
  • Review investigations and reports
  • Analyse parish HIV/STI/CI data
  • Mentor and supervise Contact Investigators
  • Support PMTCT/PrEP and programme gap assessment
Source / reference ↗

Contact Investigator

Parish / field

Conducts confidential surveillance, interviewing, case investigation, contact elicitation and notification, field follow-up, testing support and linkage to appropriate services.

Key functions
  • Hospital, clinic, laboratory and community surveillance
  • Interviewing, counselling, contact elicitation and tracing
  • Partner notification and field investigation
  • HIV/syphilis testing support within scope
  • Linkage, return-to-care, PrEP referral and PMTCT follow-up
  • Case documentation, databases and programme reports
Source / reference ↗

PMTCT Nurse / Coordinator

Parish / maternal-child network

Coordinates prevention of vertical transmission activities and maternal/infant follow-up with the multidisciplinary team.

Key functions
  • Maternal HIV/syphilis follow-up
  • Coordinate treatment and monitoring across antenatal, delivery and postnatal services
  • Support infant follow-up and programme reporting
  • Work jointly with CI and clinical teams
Source / reference ↗

Treatment-Site Clinician / Medical Officer

Treatment site

Provides HIV clinical assessment, ART management, monitoring, co-infection management and clinical decision-making.

Key functions
  • Clinical evaluation and ART management
  • Viral-load and laboratory monitoring
  • Manage co-morbidities and co-infections
  • Coordinate referrals and multidisciplinary care
Source / reference ↗

Nurse / Public Health Nurse

Treatment, testing and community services

Supports testing, counselling, treatment-site care, education, follow-up and continuity of care within nursing scope.

Key functions
  • Testing and counselling support
  • Patient education and treatment follow-up
  • Coordinate with clinicians and psychosocial staff
  • Support continuity of care
Source / reference ↗

Pharmacist / Pharmacy Team

Treatment site

Supports safe dispensing, adherence, medication counselling and continuity of antiretroviral and related therapy.

Key functions
  • Dispensing and medication counselling
  • Identify medication-related issues
  • Support adherence and continuity
  • Coordinate with clinical team
Source / reference ↗

Social Worker / Psychologist / Adherence Counsellor

Psychosocial support

Provides psychosocial assessment, counselling, adherence support, crisis/referral support and client-centred retention interventions.

Key functions
  • Psychosocial assessment and counselling
  • Adherence and retention support
  • Referral and social-support linkage
  • Support disclosure and stigma-related needs
Source / reference ↗

Monitoring & Evaluation Officer

Strategic Information

Supports indicator monitoring, data quality, analysis, reporting and programme use of information.

Key functions
  • Monitor indicators and reporting timelines
  • Data quality and validation
  • Analyse programme performance
  • Support decision-making and reporting
Source / reference ↗

Database Officer / Data Entry Clerk

Strategic Information / facility

Maintains programme databases and treatment-site records, supporting accurate, timely and confidential data entry and reporting.

Key functions
  • Enter and update programme records
  • Support data quality checks
  • Generate routine reports
  • Maintain confidentiality and access controls
Source / reference ↗

Surveillance Officer / Epidemiology Support

National / regional / parish

Supports notifiable-disease surveillance, verification, investigation, analysis, data quality and response coordination.

Key functions
  • Surveillance reporting and verification
  • Case/outbreak investigation support
  • Data analysis and dissemination
  • Coordinate surveillance response requirements
Source / reference ↗

Biostatistician / Data Analyst

Strategic Information

Supports statistical analysis, interpretation and use of HIV/STI/TB programme data for monitoring and planning.

Key functions
  • Statistical analysis
  • Trend interpretation
  • Support dashboards and programme reports
  • Translate data into programme insight
Source / reference ↗

Laboratory Personnel / Laboratory Technical Assistant

Laboratory and testing network

Supports specimen collection/processing, testing, quality requirements and timely result communication within established protocols.

Key functions
  • HIV/STI/TB testing within scope
  • Specimen handling and laboratory quality
  • Communicate results through approved channels
  • Support surveillance and clinical workflows
Source / reference ↗

Behaviour Change Communication / Prevention Team

National / regional / parish delivery

Supports targeted prevention, health promotion, testing promotion, risk-reduction communication and community interventions.

Key functions
  • Health promotion and behaviour-change communication
  • Targeted outreach and prevention interventions
  • Support testing and prevention campaigns
  • Coordinate community engagement and referrals
Source / reference ↗

TB Programme / Chest Clinic Team

National · regional · parish

Implements TB prevention, case detection, diagnosis, treatment support, contact investigation, surveillance and monitoring across the three programme levels.

Key functions
  • TB case detection and notification
  • Diagnosis/treatment coordination
  • Contact investigation and adherence support
  • TB surveillance and programme reporting
Source / reference ↗
About this resource centre

A staff doorway, not another maze.

The concept keeps authoritative materials at the centre, reduces unnecessary page-hopping, and gives staff a single route to manuals, service directories, learning and programme references.

Source priority

Current MOHW and National HIV/STI/TB Programme material first, followed by clearly labelled programme staff references and supplementary learning.
